privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: At Sun Baja Experience, your trust comes first. We are the agency that runs this website: you book services from local companies here, and this notice explains what we do with your data. Each company providing a service has its own documents; the liability waiver of each one is shown when you book.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body:
Sun Baja Experience, a local travel agency based at C. Toronja 561, Indeco, Donceles 28, 23070 La Paz, Baja California Sur, Mexico, is responsible for the personal data described in this notice, which we collect through this website.

For anything related to your data, including the requests described under «Your rights» below, contact us gladly on WhatsApp at the number shown on this site. We respond within 20 business days in accordance with applicable regulations.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body:
- **When you book:** your name, phone number, and email, plus the date, time, and number of guests for your trip.
- **When you accept the liability waiver:** your name, the date and time of acceptance, and your IP address, as proof of agreement.
- **When you pay:** the amount, currency, and a transaction reference (see «Payment data» below; we never see your card details).
- **Automatically, through cookies:** see «Cookies and browser storage» below.

We only collect what is essential to provide you with excellent service and ensure your safety during your excursion.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body:
- Recording your booking, sending it to the company that runs the service, and keeping in touch to coordinate every detail of your trip.
- Keeping on record your acceptance of the liability waiver of the company that runs your service, for your protection and that of its team.
- Processing payment securely and maintaining transaction records for accounting and tax purposes.
- Booking attribution, if you booked through a representative or referral link.

All of the above is used solely to deliver the best possible experience for you. We never sell your data or send unsolicited spam.

sections.title: Payment data
sections.body: Your card details **never** pass through our servers and we cannot access them. Payments are securely processed directly by Stripe under the highest international security standards (PCI DSS).

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body:
We share only the information strictly necessary for the operation of your trip:

- The **company that runs your service** (and its captain, driver or host) receives your name, phone number and booking details to look after you. Each company protects that data to provide its service.
- **Stripe** securely processes your payment in encrypted form.
- **Messaging and email services** are used solely to send confirmations and trip updates.

We do not sell or transfer your data to third parties for any external commercial purpose.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body:
- **Bookings and waiver records** are kept as long as needed to provide ongoing customer support and maintain required records.
- **Payment and transaction records** are kept in accordance with applicable tax and accounting requirements.
- Once these periods expire, your data is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: Your rights (ARCO rights)
sections.body:
You have the right to exercise your Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Opposition (ARCO) rights at any time:

- **Access** the personal data we hold about you.
- **Rectify** any inaccurate or outdated information.
- **Cancel** your records when no longer needed for service delivery.
- **Oppose** specific uses of your personal details.

To exercise any of these rights, simply message us on WhatsApp or email us and we will promptly attend to your request.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We protect your information through strict confidentiality protocols, limiting access only to authorized personnel directly involved in your trip logistics, and relying on trusted, top-tier technology platforms.

sections.title: Minors
sections.body: Our charters are a wonderful family-friendly experience for guests of all ages. If a minor participates, the booking and liability waiver must be accepted by a parent or legal guardian.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.body: We store essential technical data in your browser so you can complete your booking quickly and smoothly. We may also use analytics to improve site performance and usability, always respecting your preferences.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
sections.body: Any updates to this privacy policy will be posted directly here with the updated date so you remain fully informed.

page.title: Liability waiver and release for activities and tourism services
page.intro:
This is a courtesy translation. The Agreement is executed in Spanish and governed by the laws of Baja California Sur, Mexico; in case of any discrepancy between the two versions, the Spanish version prevails.

This LIABILITY WAIVER AND RELEASE FOR ACTIVITIES AND TOURISM SERVICES (the "Agreement") is entered into electronically on the acceptance date indicated below, between:

{empresa}, provider of ground transportation, water activities, or destination services corresponding to the booking made through this platform in Baja California Sur, Mexico, with reference address at C. Toronja 561, Indeco, Donceles 28, 23070 La Paz, B.C.S. (the "Released Party");

and

the person identified by the name, email address and phone number captured in the booking/acceptance form on the Released Party's website (the "Participant").

(Each individually a "Party" and together the "Parties.")

sections.title: 1. Recitals
sections.body:
1.1 Purpose of the Release. The Participant wishes to take part in sportfishing activities, ground transportation, maritime excursions, or other destination services provided, organized, or facilitated by the Released Party. As a condition of being allowed to take part in any such activities and services, the Participant enters into this liability waiver voluntarily and with full understanding of its legal consequences to protect the provider company of the booked services.

1.2 Acknowledgment of Risks. The Participant acknowledges that maritime activities, sportfishing, and ground transportation carry inherent risks, including without limitation: for aquatic activities, swell, changing weather conditions, movement of the vessel, use of hooks and fishing gear, prolonged sun exposure, and contact with marine species; and for ground transportation, vehicular traffic, road conditions, and boarding/alighting maneuvers.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
sections.body:
Unless otherwise stated, the following terms have the meanings set out below:

"Activity" means any sportfishing tour, vessel excursion, ground transportation service, lodging, or recreational activity organized, operated, or provided by the Released Party in the destination.

"Claims" means any and all liabilities, demands, actions, causes of action, lawsuits, damages, losses, costs or expenses of any kind or nature, known or unknown, foreseen or unforeseen.

"Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is electronically accepted by the Participant in connection with the booking of activities or services.

"Participant" means the person taking part in the activities or services who accepts this release of liability.

"Released Party" means {empresa} (including its drivers, captains, and tour operators), its owners, directors, officers, employees, agents, representatives, captains, crew members and affiliates.

sections.title: 3. Scope and application of the release
sections.body:
3.1 When It Applies. This release shall apply at all times while the Participant takes part in any Activity or service provided. The terms and conditions contained herein protect the provider company and shall remain in full force and effect during each participation with the Released Party.

3.2 Assumption of Risk. The Participant expressly and specifically assumes all risks associated with taking part in activities and transportation, whether foreseeable or unforeseeable, including property damage, personal injury, illness or death arising from participation in the Activity.

3.3 The Release Covers Ordinary Negligence; Gross Negligence Is Excepted. This release covers, and the Participant expressly waives, any claim arising from the ordinary negligence of the Released Party. This release does not cover, and the Released Party does not intend to release, waive or discharge liability for, gross negligence, willful misconduct or intentional acts, to the extent such a limitation is required by applicable law.

sections.title: 4. Medical treatment and emergencies
sections.body:
4.1 Consent to Emergency Medical Treatment. The Participant expressly authorizes the Released Party, its captains, drivers, and operational crew to arrange, consent to and obtain or administer first aid and emergency medical treatment on the Participant's behalf, in the event the Participant is unable to do so during the Activity, including transport to the nearest appropriate medical facility. This authorization does not obligate the Released Party to provide medical treatment, nor does it make it responsible for the cost, quality or outcome of such treatment.

4.2 Participant's Responsibility for Their Own Health. The Participant represents and warrants that they are physically fit and mentally capable of taking part in booked activities and transportation, and assumes sole responsibility for any medical expenses incurred as a result of illness or injury suffered during the Activity.

sections.title: 5. Use of likeness and photography
sections.body: 5.1 Grant of Permission. The Participant grants the Released Party, its successors and assigns, the irrevocable and unrestricted right to use, publish and copyright photographs, video and audio recordings of the Participant taken during the Activity, for promotional, commercial or any other lawful purpose, without compensation or prior approval.

sections.title: 6. Release of liability and covenant not to sue
sections.body:
6.1 Release and Discharge. The Participant, on their own behalf and on behalf of their heirs, executors, administrators and assigns, permanently releases, waives and discharges the Released Party from any claim, demand or cause of action arising from participation in the Activity or transportation, with the sole exception of claims arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct or intentional acts.

6.2 Covenant Not to Sue. The Participant covenants not to bring any legal action, lawsuit or claim against the Released Party or any participating operator for injury, loss or damage suffered during the tour, transfer, or activity, subject to the limitations set out in this Agreement.

sections.title: 7. Governing law and miscellaneous provisions
sections.body:
7.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be construed and governed in accordance with the laws of the State of Baja California Sur and the applicable federal law of the United Mexican States, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles. The Parties submit to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of La Paz, Baja California Sur.

7.2 Severability. If any provision, clause or sentence of this Agreement is held invalid, unlawful or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, such provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid and enforceable, and the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.

7.3 Entire Agreement. This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes any prior discussion, negotiation or representation, whether oral or written.

sections.title: 8. Electronic acceptance
sections.body: This Agreement is designed to be entered into electronically. By checking the acceptance box and submitting the booking/waiver form on the Released Party's website, the Participant affirmatively agrees that: (a) they have read and understood this Agreement in its entirety; (b) they are over 18 years of age, or else this Agreement has been separately accepted by their parent or legal guardian; (c) their typed full name constitutes their electronic signature; and (d) the Released Party may retain a record of the accepted text, the name typed by the Participant, and the date, time and IP address of acceptance, as evidence of this Agreement.

meta.title: About us
meta.description: We are an agency that brings together local companies in Baja California Sur: you book in one place and pay the company that takes you out.

nosotros.subtitulo: Sun Baja Experience brings together local companies in Baja California Sur so you can book fishing, whale watching, lodging and transfers in one place, and head out with people who know these waters.
nosotros.fotoAlt: Pangas on the sand by the sea
fotosAlt: An angler with his rod, by the sea
A cardón cactus by the sea
A hand holding a fishing rod at sunset
Tall cardón cacti against the evening sky
A man with open arms facing the sea

ficha.valor: Us: your date, the calendar, the payment and your questions on WhatsApp, in English and Spanish.
Each local company runs its own service: it provides the boat, the captain, the guide or the lodging.
The company that takes you out, directly, through its own account. In pesos or dollars.
If the boat cannot go out, you get a full refund.
You can change your date with at least 48 hours notice.

nosotros.whatsappMensaje: Hi, I would like to know more about Sun Baja Experience.
historia: It all started with a panga and an idea.

A sportfishing company in La Paz and a marketing team sat down to talk about the same thing: much of the management of tours and adventures in Baja was ending up in the hands of foreign companies. The captains brought the sea and the craft; others handled the booking, the payment and the relationship with the traveler.
We decided it could be different. Everyone put in what they do best: some go out on the water, others make booking a tour in Baja easy. Sun Baja Experience came out of that union.
nosotros.empresasTexto: They are local, and each one runs its own services. We do not run the tours: we make booking them clear and simple.

hubContenido.comoTexto: Sun Baja Experience brings together what each destination's local companies offer. You compare and book here; the company takes you out and charges you directly.

comoPasos.texto: Every service shows who takes you, what it costs and what's included, before you pay.
Pick a date and group size, and pay the company online. If your trip combines two companies, you'll see one charge from each.
On the day, the company meets you. If the weather keeps you ashore, you get it all back; to change your date, give 48 hours' notice.

hubContenido.empresasTexto: Independent companies from each destination. Each runs its own service, charges you directly and has its own site and socials.

hub.headline: Your next experience starts in Baja

meta.title: Sun Baja Experience | Fishing and whales in Baja Sur
meta.description: Book sportfishing, whale and orca watching, lodging and transfers in La Paz and La Ventana with local outfitters. Pay them directly; full weather refund.
